name: Vanta
description: Vanta is a trust management and security compliance automation platform for frameworks, controls, tests, evidence, personnel, devices, vendors, risk, trust centers, questionnaires, and audits.
agentUseSummary: Add customer-owned Manage Vanta API client credentials restricted to read-only scope. Selected agents can list only bounded, minimized document status metadata. Relay blocks document contents, evidence, people, audits, broad APIs, and every mutation.

credentialRequirements.name: VANTA_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Vanta API client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Client ID for a customer-owned Manage Vanta API application restricted to read-only scope.

credentialRequirements.name: VANTA_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Vanta API client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Client secret stored encrypted and submitted only to Vanta's fixed token endpoint.

capabilities.label: Read compliance document status
capabilities.description: List a bounded, minimized directory of document titles, categories, and collection statuses.

allowed.label: List compliance documents
allowed.description: List up to 20 minimized document-status records from the bound Vanta account.

blocked.label: Access evidence or change Vanta
blocked.description: Document contents and uploads, controls, tests, people, devices, vendors, risks, trust data, audits, integrations, exports, and every mutation are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One bounded document-status directory read runs directly; document contents, evidence, people, audits, broad APIs, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mints one-hour read-only tokens against Vanta's fixed origin and exposes only a bounded document-status directory.
Railway mints one-hour read-only tokens against Vanta's fixed origin and exposes only a bounded document-status directory.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer has supplied a Manage Vanta API client restricted to vanta-api.all:read, and the credential lifecycle and non-production acceptance have not been validated.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Vanta administrator creates a customer-owned API application with only vanta-api.all:read, stores its client ID and secret through Relay's encrypted credential flow, then validates token renewal, bounded document reads, scope denial, secret rotation/revocation, disconnect, rate limiting, and post-disconnect denial in non-production.

evidence.supports: Vanta documents the fixed API and token origins, JSON client-credentials grant with an explicit scope, one-hour access tokens, cursor pagination, and vanta-api.all:read authorization.

Vanta documents the Manage Vanta API document directory, GET /v1/documents, bearer authorization, pageSize and pageCursor pagination, document title/category/status fields, and sensitive upload and submit mutations that Relay excludes.
Vanta's official API index shows the broad controls, documents, people, devices, vendors, risk, trust, audit, integration, and mutating surface that remains outside this connector.
